description: How exposed is one brand drug's patent protection, in a single call. Joins the three sources a generics or biotech analyst otherwise queries by hand: FDA Orange Book listed patents and their expiry dates, USPTO PTAB proceedings (IPR/PGR) filed against those exact patent numbers, and federal ANDA / Hatch-Waxman district-court dockets naming the brand. Returns the earliest expiry NOT under challenge, which patents are actively contested, and which generic firms are litigating. Use for loss-of-exclusivity diligence, generic-entry timing, or "who is attacking this drug and where". Listed dates are FDA/USPTO/court records, not a legal conclusion about enforceability or actual launch.

application_no.description: Specific NDA/ANDA number instead of a name, e.g. "202155".

drug.description: Brand or ingredient name, e.g. "Eliquis" or "apixaban".

max_patents.description: Patents to check against PTAB (default 12, max 25). Each is one upstream call, so this bounds latency; any patents beyond the cap are still listed and counted.
